core_problem_solved: To provide the core server-side components of the Apache HBase distributed database, including the HMaster and HRegionServer functionalities.
key_features: Contains the implementation of the distributed, persistent, sorted map data store
Manages data storage on HDFS, including compactions and region splitting
Implements the server-side RPC endpoints for client requests and inter-server communication
era_and_niche: A core server-side module of the Apache HBase project. It is not typically used as a dependency by standard client applications, but rather by the HBase deployment itself or for advanced, server-side programming (like coprocessors).
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is the current, actively maintained server implementation for HBase and is the direct successor to the server functionality that was previously bundled in the monolithic `org.apache.hbase:hbase` artifact.
